</style><script>(()=> {
    const el=document.querySelector('#effortless_three_step_installation .img_with_text_box_simplicity_contain'
    );

    let isDown=false;
    let startX=0;
    let startScrollLeft=0;

    el.addEventListener('mousedown', (e)=> {
        isDown=true;
        startX=e.pageX;
        startScrollLeft=el.scrollLeft;
      });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', ()=> {
        isDown=false;
      });

    el.addEventListener('mousemove', (e)=> {
        if ( !isDown) return;
        e.preventDefault();

        const deltaX=e.pageX - startX;
        el.scrollLeft=startScrollLeft + deltaX;
      });
  })() </script>

settings.title: What's in the box
settings.text:
A: Upper Arm
B: Lower Arm
C: VESA Plate (75×75 & 100×100 mm)
D: Threaded Rod
E: Base Clamp
F: Metal Base Plate
G: Cable Clip
H: Pole Stop Clip
I: Silicone Pad
J: Black Plastic Washer (8 pcs)
K: M4×10 Phillips Screws (8 pcs)
L: M5×10 Phillips Screws (8 pcs)
M: 4 mm Hex Key (1 pc)
N: 5 mm Hex Key (1 pc)
O: 6 mm Hex Key (1 pc)

settings.heading: 1. Is this dual monitor arm compatible with my monitors?
settings.content: Yes. This dual monitor arm supports standard VESA sizes of 75×75 mm and 100×100 mm. The weight capacity and monitor sizes are clearly specified. It supports monitors from 13" to 49" and can hold up to 20 kg (44.1 lbs).

settings.heading: 2. Is this dual monitor arm easy to install?
settings.content: Yes. This easy-to-install dual monitor arm comes with all the necessary tools and instructions. Most users can complete the setup alone without professional help, making the installation fast and straightforward.

settings.heading: 3. Does the dual monitor arm support height and angle adjustment?
settings.content: Yes. This adjustable dual monitor arm for the standing desk offers smooth height adjustment, tilt, swivel, and rotation for both horizontal and vertical monitor orientations.

settings.heading: 4. Is this dual monitor arm good for gaming, office, or home setup?
settings.content: Yes. The Atlas Dual Monitor Arm is perfect for gaming, office productivity, and home setups, providing ergonomic positioning and saving desk space.

settings.heading: 5. Does using a dual monitor arm improve ergonomics?
settings.content: Yes. The dual monitor arm for the desk keeps monitors at eye level and the correct distance, reducing neck, shoulder, and eye strain for better posture.

settings.heading: 6. What warranty comes with this dual monitor arm?
settings.content: The Atlas Dual Monitor Arm comes with a 1-year warranty, covering manufacturing defects and ensuring reliable, long-term use.
